text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France's National Assembly ratifies accord with Morocco over mutual protection of investments.
- Public Works Minister Abdelaziz Meziane tells international water forum ... "kingdom built its development on rational management of water."
- Accord for setting up joint venture between Office Cherifien des Phosphates (OCP) and Indian firm will provide new market for OCP's products.
- World water forum wants to associate all parties with better management.
- Morocco's ambassador in Austria, attending meeting of drugs commission in Vienna, says Morocco devotes about $100 million annually to fighting drug trafficking.
- Foreign investment and private loans for Morocco in January 1997 rose to 510.2 million dirhams ($54.8 million) from 169.5 million dirhams in January 1996.
